githubDescription:
SakuraCord v0.1.4 adds Go Live screen sharing for voice channels and private calls, with source selection, quality controls, shared audio, and stream viewing. It also improves voice-device switching, call recovery, media-viewer interactions, profiles, messaging, and sidebar polish.

## Go Live screen sharing

- Added screen sharing for displays, windows, and applications in voice channels and private calls.
- Added a live preview with source switching, optional shared audio, 15, 30, or 60 FPS, and 720p, 1080p, 1440p, or source-quality output.
- Added stream tiles with Watch, Stop Watching, Retry, paused, and live states directly in the call grid.
- Added recognizable sounds when screen sharing starts or ends and when participants join or leave a stream.

## Voice calls and devices

- Improved microphone and speaker switching without ending the active call, including saved device preferences and safe fallback when a selected device becomes unavailable.
- Added automatic recovery when audio hardware changes or voice and Gateway connections are interrupted.
- Improved disconnected and reconnecting call feedback while keeping camera and screen-sharing stop controls available.
- Fixed intermittent ringing for incoming direct-message calls.
- Updated call-join buttons to use the selected macOS accent color.

## Media viewer

- Added animated transitions between timeline images and the media viewer.
- Added interactive pinch-to-dismiss while preserving zooming and panning.
- Reduced media-viewer presentation latency and polished opening, closing, and source-image transitions.

## Profiles, messages, and servers

- Added animated profile banners and improved themed Nitro profile backgrounds, avatars, decorations, and effects.
- Prevented animated server icons from flickering when their animated content loads.
- Added Shift-click message deletion to bypass the confirmation step.
- Fixed manual mark-as-unread state and improved spoiler hit targets, including spoilers containing inline mentions.
- Hid duplicate unread and mention indicators on expanded server folders while preserving indicators on their individual servers.

## Interface polish and reliability

- Improved channel and direct-message sidebar scrolling so content remains reachable around the account controls.
- Added a custom GIF composer icon and fixed native timeline symbol rendering.
- Improved screen-share stability under transport pressure and aligned stream signaling more closely with Discord.
- Removed obsolete platform checks and streamlined development and release documentation for the current macOS target.

**Full Changelog:** [v0.1.3...v0.1.4](https://github.com/SakuraCordApp/SakuraCord/compare/v0.1.3...v0.1.4)
discordAnnouncement:
**Go Live screen sharing and more reliable calls 🌸**

**Highlights**
- Share a display, window, or app in voice channels and private calls, with a live preview, source controls, and optional audio
- Choose 15–60 FPS and 720p, 1080p, 1440p, or source quality, then watch streams directly in the call grid
- Switch microphones and speakers without dropping the call, with automatic recovery when devices change
- Smoother media viewing with timeline-to-viewer animations and pinch-to-dismiss
- Fixed intermittent DM ringing and improved voice reconnection and screen-share stability
- Animated profile banners, cleaner Nitro profiles, Shift-click message deletion, and better unread and spoiler interactions
